details: Bitcoin has seen a significant sell-off, dropping below $63,000 and retesting its 200-week moving average, a key technical support level previously marking market bottoms in past bear cycles. The broader cryptocurrency market has also experienced a downturn, with the global crypto market cap falling by over 3% in the last 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Retests Critical 200-Week Moving Average Amid Market Downturn

details: Glassnode's Altcoin Cycle Signal has reached 86, typically indicating "altcoin season" where smaller tokens outperform Bitcoin. However, the current reading is attributed to Bitcoin's rapid decline rather than a surge in altcoin demand, suggesting underlying market weakness.
title: Altcoin Season Signal Flashes Due to Bitcoin Weakness, Not Altcoin Strength

details: The Wall Street Journal has reportedly exposed approximately $1.9 million in fabricated winning bets on Polymarket, a decentralized prediction market platform. This revelation raises concerns about the integrity and transparency within certain segments of the crypto prediction market space.
title: Wall Street Journal Report Uncovers Fabricated Polymarket Wins

details: The Bank of England has announced the removal of individual stablecoin holdings limits, a move that could significantly ease the adoption and integration of stablecoins within the UK financial system. This regulatory adjustment signals a more accommodating stance towards digital assets from a major central bank.
title: Bank of England Removes Individual Stablecoin Holdings Limits

details: Ripple has obtained a preliminary Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) license, which is a significant regulatory approval for its operations within the European Union. This development positions Ripple favorably for expansion and compliance within Europe's evolving digital asset landscape.
title: Ripple Secures Preliminary MiCA License in Europe

details: A major Japanese pension fund plans to allocate 1% of its portfolio to cryptocurrencies starting in 2026. This move is intended to hedge against a weakening US dollar, highlighting a growing institutional interest in digital assets as a diversification tool and a store of value.
title: Japanese Pension Fund to Allocate to Crypto as Dollar Hedge
